{{Top|leg}}
'''Infradig rays''' were a range of [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] light wavelengths emitted by lighting equipment. While the rays were harmless, many individuals purchased special [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] to block the rays during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|103|infradig rays}}</ref>
